To move your vault to the new layout, run these steps in order.

1. Quit arcterm.
2. Copy `~/.arc/vault` to a backup folder.
3. Run `wsh vault migrate`.
4. Start arcterm and open Setup → Memory.
5. Check that each project's notes are there.
6. Delete the backup once you are sure.

## Waiting on you
Step 3 rewrites every note's front matter, so the backup in step 2 is the only way back. Tell me when it is done and I will remove the old reader.
